newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paris full-freighter flights up 21.5 pct Jan-May 9.
newsitem.headline: Paris full-freighter flights up 21.5 pct Jan-May 9.

text.p: Full-freighter flights at the Paris airports in the first five months of 1997 totalled 9,044, an increase of 21.5 percent on the same period the previous year, Paris airport authority (ADP) figures show.
Freighter flights operating at CDG totalled 8,262, an increase of 23.2 percent on January-May 1996 and by 5.7 percent from Orly to 782.
ADP' January-May 1997 total air cargo throughput amounted to 456,714 tonnes with the full freighters share at 41.2 percent of the overall figure, compared to 39.3 percent in January-May 1996.
In tonnage terms, full freighters moved 188,246 tonnes in the first five months of 1997, a rise of 7.3 percent on 1996 levels.
Full-freighter flights accounted for 3.6 percent of all flights operating at the Paris airports in January-May 1997 compared to three percent in the same 1996 period.
